parsed.why: No trans-specific offence, no state harassment, same-sex conduct legal since 2020; but common individual harassment, thin recourse, military rule and only occasional modesty-charge misuse against gender-nonconforming people.

Criminalisation applied to foreigners via deportation and arrest, abusive detention with torture, no organisations or recourse, government uses 'gay' as an insult; authoritarian rule and dated enforcement still imply structural severity.

Self-ID, X markers, working anti-discrimination rulings, marriage equality; offsets are a 2024 Supreme Court birth-sex prison-placement ruling, recurring hate speech and one 2024 hotel murder of a trans migrant.

Appearance-based arrest expressly criminalised; two trans women got five-year maximum terms for wearing women's clothing, 2022 security-force arrests and beatings, police extortion, no lawyers, NGO raided — state-tolerated trans targeting.

Cross-dressing itself an offence with multi-year convictions, same-sex conduct criminal, mandatory deportation, care banned, plus first-hand border strip-search of a genderqueer visitor — universal, traveller-facing exposure with no remedy.
